scope: Formalizes only Lemma lem:band (the norm-band multiplicity bound, four occurrences improved to two) of DaysSky's research note in DaysSky/van-der-waerden-refinement: points on a real affine line, pairwise separated by distance at least one, have at most two squared norms in any single half-open interval [m, m+1), proved in a general real inner product space in the note's own arclength parameterization. The upstream affinity/separation lemmas, the note's parameter transfers consuming lem:band (its c = 1/25 region), its run lemmas, and the row's current c = 1/9 leader (which counts short-period runs and does not use lem:band) remain written proofs.
